name: gradient-border
title: Gradient Border
description: A single navy card on black, wrapped in a slim indigo gradient outline that keeps rotating. Inside sits a rounded hillside photo, a small white heading and two lines of grey copy.
use: A feature or product card needs a premium animated edge to draw the eye without adding more UI.
avoid: The border loops forever with no pause, and the card photo, heading and caption are baked into the demo.
a11y: The border animation loops indefinitely and ignores reduced-motion; the card has no controls, so keyboard access is not relevant. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A tall dark navy rounded card floats on a black page. A thin border glows cobalt along one side and fades to slate elsewhere. Inside, a rounded photo of whitewashed houses under a pale sky sits above a small white heading and two short centred grey lines.
behaves: A conic gradient sweeps around the card's edge in a steady four-second loop, so the bright blue segment travels from corner to corner while the photo and text stay still.
customise: The photo path, heading and caption are hardcoded; border colours, thickness and the four-second spin are fixed in a class string.
weight: light: One card and a single animated CSS border; no canvas, script or extra nodes.
